details: Package @accenturecodefoundry/mfe-pot-shared-ui-scds-core@99.99.41 runs a preinstall script (`node index.js || true`) that issues an HTTPS GET to a hardcoded host, `https://accenture-npm.azurewebsites.net/mfe`. The request has a static path, no body, and no response handling — nothing is fetched back or executed. The 99.99.41 version number on a scoped placeholder, combined with the Azure Websites host under an Accenture-themed subdomain, is consistent with a defensive dependency-confusion canary published by the scope owner to detect which internal networks resolve the scoped name to the public registry. The installer-side effect is limited to disclosing source IP and install timing to the operator of that host at `npm install` time; no installer secrets, environment variables, filesystem contents, or credentials are read or transmitted, and no remote code is fetched or executed.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
